decision.reason: The only evidence is one changelog line [ev-da7ff24b2c60]. It says Strimzi "adopted new Kafka Connect health check endpoint" and points to proposal 89, which isn't excerpted. The line doesn't say which Strimzi resources use the health check (for example, whether KafkaMirrorMaker2 is covered as well as KafkaConnect). It also doesn't say whether exposure depends on a Kafka version or a configuration, and it states no consequence the exposure condition could be tied to. So I can't confirm that gvk-in-use KafkaConnect (with no group) is exactly right rather than too broad or too narrow; to decide, I'd need the proposal 89 text or upgrade notes that name the affected resources and conditions.
